# Create an alert rule in Northwind Relay

Create an alert rule so that Northwind Relay notifies you when a stream stops delivering messages.

## Steps

To create an alert rule, complete the following steps.

1. In the main menu, click **Alert rules**. The **Alert rules** page lists every rule in the workspace.
2. Click **New alert rule**. The rule editor opens with the **Condition** tab selected.
3. Click **Save rule**. The rule appears on the **Alert rules** page with the state **Normal**.
